observations: Photo 0: an orange gas cylinder wrapped in black protective netting, standing on pavement in a street/market setting.
Photo 0: brass valve visible at top, cylinder appears unused/glossy with no dents or rust.
Photo 0: a stylized logo/mark (dark triangular shape) printed on the body, but no readable brand name or capacity text.

Photo 1: close-up of the cylinder's neck/valve area, showing the brass valve fitting and a handwritten 'MX' mark in black marker, but no stamped capacity, manufacturer plate, country-of-origin mark, or manufacture/test date visible.
No regulator, hose, or gas burner shown to test fitting or function.
Background shows an outdoor market scene, consistent with a street vendor or reseller setting.

claims.evidence: No capacity stamp or embossed kg marking visible in photo 0 or photo 1; size looks plausible for a 12kg cylinder but cannot be confirmed from the image.

claims.claim: Foreign (implying imported, possibly higher quality) cylinder
claims.evidence: No country-of-origin stamp, import marking, or manufacturer plate visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Actual water/gas capacity not confirmed; could be mislabeled or a different size than 12kg.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped capacity/kg marking usually embossed near the neck or base of the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unverified-capacity cylinder, not guaranteed 12kg

risks.risk: Valve thread/fitting standard may not match local Nigerian LPG regulators (common issue with 'foreign' cylinders).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of valve threads or a video showing a standard regulator being screwed on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing a compatibility check/adapter, not guaranteed plug-and-play

risks.risk: No visible manufacture or last-test date stamp, which affects safety and resale/refill eligibility.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped manufacture/test date on the cylinder collar or body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, treated as needing re-certification

risks.risk: Cylinder could be refurbished/repainted rather than genuinely new, despite glossy 'unused' look.
risks.proof: Photo of original purchase receipt, import paperwork, or un-retouched surface under netting showing no weld repairs/rust spots.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly refurbished, not confirmed new

risks.risk: Leak or valve damage not detectable from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of a soap-bubble leak test or pressure test with gas connected.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified functional, worst case treated as potentially leaking

proof_requests: Close-up of the stamped capacity (kg) and manufacturer/country marking on the cylinder neck or shoulder.
Close-up of the valve threads or a video showing a standard regulator attaching correctly.
Photo of the manufacture/test date stamp.
Video of a leak/pressure test with gas connected, if available.
Any purchase receipt or import documentation supporting the 'foreign' claim.
response.reason: This is a standard LPG cylinder identifiable by type; although capacity, origin, and fitting compatibility are unverified from the photos, it can still be priced at a conservative worst-case level pending the proofs listed.
